package domain

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestCanonicalReceiptUsesStableCommandAndMaterializedContract(t *testing.T) {
	request := AssistantUIActionRequest{Schema: AssistantUIActionSchema, DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", MessageID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", MessageVersion: 1, BlockID: "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", ActionID: "direction.backend", IdempotencyKey: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"}
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 9, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	receipt, err := NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(request, "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", now, now.Add(time.Minute), OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if receipt.CanonicalMessageCommandID == "" || receipt.CanonicalMessageCommandID == receipt.IdempotencyKey || receipt.ExecutionMode != OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical {
		t.Fatalf("receipt=%+v", receipt)
	}
	receipt.Status = OnboardingReceiptMaterialized
	receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID = "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	receipt.ClaimToken = ""
	receipt.LockedUntil = nil
	receipt.CompletedAt = &now
	normalized, err := NormalizeOnboardingActionReceipt(receipt)
	if err != nil || normalized.Status != OnboardingReceiptMaterialized {
		t.Fatalf("normalized=%+v err=%v", normalized, err)
	}
	result, err := normalized.CanonicalResult(false)
	if err != nil || result.V2 == nil || result.V2.Schema != AssistantUIActionResultV2Schema || result.V2.CanonicalStudentMessageID != receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID {
		t.Fatalf("result=%+v err=%v", result, err)
	}
}

func TestCanonicalMaterializationUsesExactNestedJSONContract(t *testing.T) {
	input := CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization{
		Schema: CanonicalStudentTurnMaterializationSchema, DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", PersonalTeacherID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		ActionReceiptID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", CanonicalMessageCommandID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", CorrelationID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", CausationID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		SourceMessageID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", SourceMessageVersion: 1, BlockID: "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", ActionID: "direction.backend", SourceUIDigest: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", Body: "I choose: Backend",
	}
	encoded, err := input.MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	text := string(encoded)
	for _, required := range []string{"\"identity\"", "\"canonical_body\":\"I choose: Backend\"", "canonical-student-turn-interaction.v1", "source_prompt_message_version", "source_ui_digest"} {
		if !contains(text, required) {
			t.Fatalf("encoded=%s missing %q", text, required)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"\"body\"", "\"canonical_body\":\"\""} {
		if contains(text, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("encoded=%s contains forbidden %q", text, forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func contains(value, fragment string) bool {
	for index := 0; index+len(fragment) <= len(value); index++ {
		if value[index:index+len(fragment)] == fragment {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
